NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR TYPE-1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT AT
1215-1225 WEST BELMONT AVENUE

The Applicant requests a zoning change for the property located at 1215-1225 West Belmont Avenue
(the “Property”) from the C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District to B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use
District in order to construct a 5-story, 58 ft. 6 in. tall, mixed-use building (the “Project”). The Project
consists of 40 residential dwelling units on the 2nd through Sth floors, approximately 2,232 square feet
of commercial space on the ground floor, and a common rooftop deck. There will also be 24 vehicle
parking spaces and 40 bicycle parking spaces. The Project is approximately 264 feet from the
77/Belmont Avenue CTA bus line and approximately 1,501 feet from the Belmont CTA train stop
